references.text: Verse 44 is the prophetic condition that is confirmed as fulfilled in verse 51.
Verse 58 is the necessary human response to the call in verse 51.
Verse 51 is the fulfillment of the mission given in verse 4.
Both verses concern God's blessing on a woman who will become the mother of a great nation.
Verse 10 is the prophetic definition that is confirmed as fulfilled in verse 51.
Verse 60 is the blessing that follows the call in verse 51.
Both verses concern God's election to fulfill the promise of offspring.
